integration_3d.id_rule: Products already in the 3D plan keep their exact 3D ids (e.g. LR-RUG-A). New lookbook products use LB-<CATEGORY>-NN ids, which never collide with 3D ids.
integration_3d.fields: Every product carries dimensions (inches), main_color_hex, image_file, condition/taxed, price, model_3d_url, slot_3d and placement_3d.
integration_3d.placement: placement_3d = 'slot' means the product can swap into that 3D slot (slot_3d; 'A|B' means either). 'free placement' means it goes to the 3D inventory and David places it anywhere.
integration_3d.unknown_dimensions: If any of w_in/d_in/h_in is null, the 3D app must not invent it: show the item in the inventory with a 'size needed' badge and block placement until the size is supplied.
